note: v1 items, with the superior item reduced to 1 or 2 folia plus a bifid tick per folium (1.5 configurations derived post hoc from the folium lengths), and landmarks placed on one mid-sagittal slice, from which distances in mm are measured. Landmark definitions are a first draft.
images: Preprocessed T1w: MNI152-registered, 0.5 mm isotropic, cropped around the cerebellum (cerebellar_tiles). Median sagittal plane located with the aqueduct of Sylvius and the fastigium.

superior.label: Superior fastigial zone (SZFg)
superior.description: Folia in the SZFg, between the velum boundary and the first large-enough folium of the culmen (excluded). A folium is large enough if it reaches the convex outline of the vermis. Tick a folium that splits into 2 smaller folia (bifid). 1.5 configurations are not coded : they come from the folium lengths.

inferior.label: Inferior vermis (B6 pyramis, B7 uvula)
inferior.description: Attachment of B6 (pyramis branch) and B7 (uvula branch) relative to the ZFg and B5 (folium branch).

choices.1: B6 and B7 connected to the ZFg
choices.2: B7 connected to the ZFg, B6 translated onto B5
choices.3: B6 and B7 translated onto B5, none on the ZFg, clearly separated
choices.4: B6 and B7 translated onto B5, attached at the same region
choices.5: B6 and B7 translated onto B5, one attached on the other (e.g. B7 on B6)
choices.6: One attached on the other (as 5), attachment on the fastigial zone

lingula.label: Lingular zone
lingula.description: Presence of a folium on the superior medullary velum.

extra_choices.ND: Not determinable (e.g. image quality too poor)
extra_choices.S: Strange: folia clearly visible but configuration not in the table

fastigium.label: Fastigium
fastigium.description: Apex of the roof of the fourth ventricle.

culmen_conn.label: Culmen connection
culmen_conn.description: Point where the white-matter branch of the culmen joins the trunk, on the fastigial side.

b5_root.label: B5 root
b5_root.description: Point where B5 (folium branch) leaves the central white-matter trunk: the end of the fastigial zone along B5.

b5_branch.label: B5 branching
b5_branch.description: Point of the B5 division that separates the declive, the folium and the tuber (not necessarily the first split of B5).

b6_attach.label: B6 attachment
b6_attach.description: Point where the white-matter branch of B6 (pyramis) joins the tree (ZFg, B5 or B7).

b7_attach.label: B7 attachment
b7_attach.description: Point where the white-matter branch of B7 (uvula) joins the tree (ZFg, B5 or B6).

sup1_conn.label: SZFg folium 1, connection
sup1_conn.description: Point where the white-matter branch of the first SZFg folium (closest to the velum) joins the trunk.

sup1_tip.label: SZFg folium 1, tip
sup1_tip.description: Distal end of the white-matter lamina of the first SZFg folium (bifid : of its longer branch).

sup1_split.label: SZFg folium 1, split
sup1_split.description: Point where the bifid first SZFg folium splits into its two branches.

sup2_conn.label: SZFg folium 2, connection
sup2_conn.description: Point where the white-matter branch of the second SZFg folium joins the trunk.

sup2_tip.label: SZFg folium 2, tip
sup2_tip.description: Distal end of the white-matter lamina of the second SZFg folium (bifid : of its longer branch).

sup2_split.label: SZFg folium 2, split
sup2_split.description: Point where the bifid second SZFg folium splits into its two branches.

lingula_root.label: Lingula, root
lingula_root.description: Point where the white matter of the lingular folium leaves the velum.

lingula_tip.label: Lingula, tip
lingula_tip.description: Distal end of the lingular folium.

ref_fastigium_b5root.description: Length of the fastigial zone along B5 (reference scale).

culmen_from_fastigium.description: How far the culmen connection sits from the fastigium.

b5_branch_from_root.description: Length of the B5 stem up to its declive / folium / tuber division.

b6_from_fastigium.description: How far the B6 attachment sits from the fastigium.

b7_from_fastigium.description: How far the B7 attachment sits from the fastigium.

b6_from_b5root.description: B6 attachment relative to the end of the fastigial zone.

b7_from_b5root.description: B7 attachment relative to the end of the fastigial zone.

b6_b7.description: Distance between the B6 and B7 attachments (together vs separated).

sup1_length.description: Length of the first SZFg folium.

sup2_length.description: Length of the second SZFg folium (1.5 vs 2 as a ratio with sup1_length).

sup_conn_gap.description: Distance between the two SZFg connections (one vs two connections).

sup1_split_from_conn.description: Stem length of the bifid first folium before it splits.

sup2_split_from_conn.description: Stem length of the bifid second folium before it splits.
